svg.aria-label: Animated terminal introducing Jatin Agrawal, then listing and entering six pinned repositories to show their descriptions in a scrolling session.

g.text: Audit of presentation effects and biases in Jev, Clef Flash, and Perplexity Decider
across humor, helpfulness, and summarization. Includes 702,000 recorded judgments and
Human and automated evaluation of humor across five Qwen3 models (8B–235B), examining
scaling effects and judge biases. Code, data, and analyses for the CHum 2026 paper.
GTVH-guided humor generation with a five-stage DSPy pipeline and Gemma 3 27B. Placed
2nd in Chinese humor generation and GIF fill-in-the-blank at SemEval 2026 Task 1.
End-to-end visual novel generation: QLoRA-tuned Gemma 2-2B, an Elo-based creativity
benchmark, decoding experiments, and a browser engine for branching stories.
Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformer built from scratch for XSum summarization, with
learned and hash routing, load-balancing experiments, GQA and LoRA variants, and
A short narrative game exploring bullying and bystander behavior through two
perspectives. Made with RPG Maker MZ; browser and Windows builds, story/event data,
